Correct a stale unit comment on calcSpecificMoe. It read 'MOE (GPa) / density (kg/m3) x 10^6 ... identical to radiation ratio squared x 10^-6'. Both halves were wrong: that expression is 1000x below the function's actual return, and c^2 is rho^2 times the squared radiation ratio, not 10^-6 times it. The function returns E_Pa/rho = c^2 exactly and computeIndices divides by 1e6 to publish the governed c^2/10^6 profile. Comment text only.
